# 1 Samuel Chapter 12 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 188-189 | **Source Image:** 1SA_012_page_001.jpg, 1SA_012_page_002.jpg

---

**12:1** And-said Samuel to all Israel, "Behold, I-have-listened to-your-voice in-all that you-said to-me, and-I-have-made-king over-you a-king.

**12:2** And-now, behold, the-king walks before-you, and-I have-grown-old and-gray-headed, and-behold, my-sons [are] with-you. And-I have-walked before-you from-my-youth until this day.

**12:3** Here-I-am; testify against-me before YHWH and-before his-anointed-one (*meshicho*): whose ox have-I-taken, or-whose donkey have-I-taken, or-whom have-I-defrauded, [or]-whom have-I-oppressed, or-from-whose hand have-I-taken a-ransom and-I-will-hide my-eyes from-him? And-I-will-restore [it] to-you."

**12:4** And-they-said, "You-have-not-defrauded us, and-you-have-not-oppressed us, and-you-have-not-taken from-[the]-hand of-any-man anything."

**12:5** And-he-said to-them, "Witness [is] YHWH against-you, and-witness [is] his-anointed-one this day, that you-have-not-found in-my-hand anything." And-they-said, "[He is] witness."

**12:6** And-said Samuel to the-people, "[It is] YHWH who made (*asah*) Moses and Aaron, and who brought-up your-fathers from-[the]-land of-Egypt.

**12:7** And-now, stand-yourselves, and-I-will-judge with-you before YHWH [concerning] all [the]-righteous-acts of-YHWH (*tsidqot YHWH*) which he-did with-you and-with your-fathers.

**12:8** When Jacob came [to] Egypt, and-your-fathers cried-out to YHWH, and-YHWH sent Moses and Aaron, and-they-brought-out your-fathers from-Egypt, and-he-made-them-dwell in-this place.

**12:9** And-they-forgot YHWH their-God, and-he-sold them into-[the]-hand of-Sisera, commander of-[the]-army of-Hazor, and-into-[the]-hand of-[the]-Philistines, and-into-[the]-hand of-[the]-king of-Moab, and-they-fought against-them.

**12:10** And-they-cried-out to YHWH and-said, 'We-have-sinned, for we-have-forsaken YHWH and-served the-Baalim and-the-Ashtaroth. And-now, deliver-us from-[the]-hand of-our-enemies, and-we-will-serve you.'

**12:11** And-YHWH sent Yerub-Baal (*Jerubbaal*) and-Bedan and-Yiphtach (*Jephthah*) and-Samuel, and-he-delivered you from-[the]-hand of-your-enemies on-every-side, and-you-dwelt securely.

**12:12** And-you-saw that Nahash [the]-king of-[the]-sons of-Ammon came against-you, and-you-said to-me, 'No, but a-king shall-reign over-us' -- and-YHWH your-God [was] your-king.

**12:13** And-now, behold the-king whom you-have-chosen, whom you-have-asked-for; and-behold, YHWH has-set over-you a-king.

**12:14** If you-will-fear YHWH, and-serve him, and-listen to-his-voice, and-not rebel-against [the]-mouth of-YHWH, then-you-will-be -- both you and-the-king who reigns over-you -- after YHWH your-God.

**12:15** And-if you-will-not listen to-[the]-voice of-YHWH, and-you-rebel against [the]-mouth of-YHWH, then-will-be [the]-hand of-YHWH against-you and-against your-fathers.

**12:16** Also now, stand-yourselves and-see this great thing which YHWH [is]-doing before-your-eyes.

**12:17** [Is it] not wheat-harvest today? I-will-call to YHWH, and-he-will-give thunders (*qolot*) and-rain, and-know and-see that your-evil [is] great which you-have-done in-[the]-eyes of-YHWH, in-asking for-yourselves a-king."

**12:18** And-Samuel called to YHWH, and-YHWH gave thunders and-rain on-that day. And-all the-people feared exceedingly YHWH and Samuel.

**12:19** And-said all the-people to Samuel, "Pray on-behalf-of your-servants to YHWH your-God, and-let-us-not-die, for we-have-added to all our-sins [this] evil, to-ask for-ourselves a-king."

**12:20** And-said Samuel to the-people, "Do-not-fear. You have-done all this evil; only do-not-turn-aside from-after YHWH, and-serve YHWH with-all your-heart.

**12:21** And-do-not-turn-aside after the-emptiness (*tohu*) which cannot-profit and-cannot-deliver, for they [are] emptiness.

**12:22** For YHWH will-not-abandon his-people, on-account-of his-great name, for YHWH has-been-pleased to-make you for-himself into-a-people.

**12:23** Also I -- far-be-it-from-me to-sin against YHWH by-ceasing to-pray on-your-behalf. And-I-will-instruct you in-the-way [that is] good and-right.

**12:24** Only fear YHWH, and-serve him in-truth with-all your-heart, for see what great-things he-has-done with-you.

**12:25** And-if you-will-indeed-do-evil (*harea tareu*), both you and-your-king shall-be-swept-away."

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

1. **12:3 -- "ransom"** (כֹּפֶר, *kopher*): The Leningrad Codex reads כֹּפֶר here. The LXX adds "or a pair of sandals" (cf. the longer Greek reading), but the MT (as in L) is shorter. The word kopher means a covering-price or ransom.

2. **12:11 -- "Bedan"** (בְּדָן): This name is difficult; the LXX reads "Barak" (Βαράκ), and some suggest an emendation. The Leningrad Codex clearly preserves בְּדָן. Some identify Bedan with Samson or with Jair.

3. **12:11 -- "and-Samuel"**: Samuel mentions himself in the third person in the Leningrad Codex. The LXX reads "Samuel" here as well; some suggest the original may have read "Samson" (שִׁמְשׁוֹן) rather than "Samuel" (שְׁמוּאֵל).

4. **12:14 -- Conditional sentence**: The Hebrew apodosis (the "then" clause) is grammatically incomplete in the MT. The verse literally reads: "if you fear...then you will be -- both you and the king -- after YHWH your God." The sense is "you will follow YHWH" but the verb of the consequence is syntactically implied.

5. **12:15 -- "against your fathers"**: The Leningrad Codex reads בַּאֲבֹתֵיכֶם ("against your fathers"). Some manuscripts and versions read "against your king" (בְּמַלְכְּכֶם), which fits the context better. The ketiv-qere tradition varies here.

6. **12:17 -- "thunders" (*qolot*)**: Literally "voices" -- the Hebrew קֹלוֹת is used for both thunder and voices. Thunder during wheat harvest (late May/June) is extremely rare in Israel, underscoring the miraculous sign.

7. **12:21 -- "emptiness" (*tohu*)**: The same word used in Genesis 1:2 (תֹהוּ, "formless/void"). Here it refers to idols -- things of nothingness.

-- EMET (אֱמֶת)
